verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents point-in-time sandbox snapshots with rollback and forking (blaxel-docs-21), plus CI pipeline integration via a GitHub Action (blaxel-docs-13) which implies some deploy/version workflow, but there is no explicit documentation of versioning or review for agent/automation configurations themselves (only sandboxes). Missing for 10: version history for agent/automation definitions, an explicit review/approval workflow, and rollback of deployed agents/workflows (not just sandboxes).
